acceptance.validator: HARNESS VALIDATION PASSED: 29 skills, 1 unreleased candidates, 3 adapters, no high-confidence secrets.

evidence: The private ai-harness Codex Cloud environment was published from the immutable release commit with a checksum-pinned PowerShell bootstrap, persistent pwsh and Python shims on the normal fresh-task PATH, all three XDG variables, and a governed Start skill. A new cloud task resolved both shims, observed the exact repository commit and a clean tree, and passed the full harness validator without leaving changes. The Codex custom-instructions field was separately populated from the canonical cloud adapter and read back exactly.
limitations: Codex Cloud's default command sandbox suppresses stdout from nested Node subprocesses in this validator; the accepted run used explicitly authorized full command permissions.
The published Start skill records that boundary and requires immediate user approval before the full-permission readiness check.
